li: Open adult beginner classes, no experience needed
Annual spring performance at the Civic Theatre
p: A working studio for dancers who want the real thing. Small classes, live piano, and teachers who trained on the stages they are preparing you for.
Founded in 1998, International Dance has sent graduates to companies across four continents while keeping its doors open to anyone who wants to take a first class at forty.
Two sprung floors, natural light, and a barre with room to breathe.
Winter term begins the second week of January and runs fourteen weeks through the spring showcase.
Placement for new students is by appointment. Bring soft shoes; we will tell you the rest.
Adult open classes need no registration. Arrive ten minutes early.
Every instructor has danced professionally. Every instructor is still in the studio five days a week.
Faculty trained at the Vaganova Academy, the Royal Ballet School, and the Paris Opera Ballet School.
Class sizes are capped at twelve so corrections are given by name, not to the room.
Observation windows let parents watch without disrupting class.
Changing rooms, secure lockers, and a quiet study area for dancers between classes.
Street parking is free after six. The tram stops at the corner.
